title: Northgate Tire Center Road Hazard Credit — Member Acceptance Reference
content:
# Road hazard credit on a Northgate Tire Center package

**What the rule settles.** The road hazard credit is the credit booked on a Northgate Tire Center package against the most recent road hazard replacement entry recorded on the package, for the wheel position on that entry. The member accepts the credit, and it is applied only toward that wheel's replacement.

**Observable effect.** Once accepted, the package shows one road hazard credit entry for the wheel, dated on the day it is accepted and linked to the road hazard replacement entry; the package's balance of Tire Center charges falls by the amount, and the accepted credit appears with the package's other charges and credits as applied toward that wheel's replacement. Nothing else on the package changes.

## The acceptance tool: `accept_road_hazard_credit_d64b14f0`

**Capability.** `accept_road_hazard_credit_d64b14f0` lets the member accept the road hazard adjustment member services has worked out for one wheel of their Tire Center installation package, linked to the road hazard replacement entry of that wheel. One call adds exactly one road hazard credit entry, dated today, for the wheel.

**How it is invoked.** This tool belongs to the member. Member services unlocks it for the member with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves then runs `accept_road_hazard_credit_d64b14f0` with the values member services gives them.

**Parameters.**

- `tire_service_id` — the installation package reference number of the member's tire set, as given to the member by member services.
- `tire_position` — the wheel the credit is for, exactly one of: `left_front` (the damaged tire was on the driver-side front wheel), `right_front` (passenger-side front wheel), `left_rear` (driver-side rear wheel), `right_rear` (passenger-side rear wheel), `spare` (the damaged tire is the full-size spare), `all_positions` (one credit covering every wheel of the set at once).
- `source_event_id` — the reference number of the road hazard replacement entry being credited, as given to the member by member services.
- `amount` — the credit the member accepts, in USD with 2 decimal places, zero or more; the value is passed already worked out to the cent and is booked as given.

| Parameter | Format |
|---|---|
| `tire_service_id` | package reference number (text) |
| `tire_position` | one of the six wheel values |
| `source_event_id` | road hazard replacement entry reference number (text) |
| `amount` | USD, 2 decimal places, zero or more |

**Return.** A receipt rendered as text with: `tire_event_id`, the reference number of the accepted credit entry; `tire_service_id`, the package credited; `charge_component`, always `road_hazard_credit`; `tire_position`, the wheel credited; `service_date`, today's date (YYYY-MM-DD); `amount`, the credit accepted in USD with 2 decimal places; and `status`, "accepted" when the entry was added. A receipt with status "accepted" means the credit now stands on the package.
